native.observations: Created note opens from acknowledged chat activity. Locked title remains while body changes. Restart restores Undo; clicking it restores exact prior blocks. Human text remains after stale Undo refusal. Wide and820px layouts inspected: controls remain reachable, narrow reading column is cramped and summary truncates. Initial light startup and long private-runtime waits remain in full video; accepted stills and excerpt are dark. Expanded API tool traces and existing opaque history label remain; this is bounded functional acceptance, not a polished narrow layout or recovery UI claim.

standard.limitations: Existing GIF palette banding in modal shadows; PNGs retain actual gradients.

live.provider: Real Claude on isolated runtime; showcase paper, separate from scripted native ordinary-note model decisions.

limits: P2/A2 remains open; no deletion/recovery, migration activation, legacy retirement or portability.
Native model choices are scripted through actual SDK; actual stdio MCP transport is tested separately.
Uncertain create readback never replays POST; uncertain edit-response recovery and arbitrary crash boundaries remain unproved.
Additional locked slots refuse whole-body replacement. Agent title editing remains unsupported.
Profile switch during an in-flight ordinary-note creation is not covered.
No merge or deployment; fresh hosted results apply only to pushed head.
efficiency: Perform cheap fixture/probe checks before native recordings. Serialize standard pending-pointer mutation after isolated capture source checks. Group code-area README edits before source commit; reuse unchanged passing suites and rerun affected scope tests for the final settings correction.

accounting.note: Timestamp interval covers retained final-check work only, not all implementation time. Total active/wait time and trustworthy token usage are unavailable. Earlier fixture and assertion retries retained in the handoff.
